buyer.notes: Firm's own pages state it pursues value-add, core, opportunistic, core+ and credit logistics investments and selectively acquires properties designed and built with users' needs in mind, including leased investments and vacant or short-term leased facilities (hold_strategy column shows only the first of several stated strategies). News boilerplate: 'mission critical, transportation-advantaged logistics real estate with high flow through characteristics, designed to move - not store - freight'. Equity: Realterm Logistics Fund V (Nebraska Investment Council public doc) and JV capital with J.P. Morgan (1.75 msf HFT portfolio in 28 markets). Realterm also originates credit ($300M loan on six-property transport infrastructure portfolio). NJ deals seen: Totowa NJ 6,960 SF IOS facility (year n/a; dcvelocity); Jersey City NJ 60,000 SF transload, 54 dock positions (year n/a); North Bergen NJ final-mile warehouse (year n/a). Acquires assets as small as 23,634 SF on 3.9 ac (San Diego) up to 200,400 SF final-mile (Houston). Additional NJ deals seen: Linden NJ 30-door final-mile truck terminal (ajot.com, year n/a); 'highly functional truck terminal in New Jersey' (ajot.com, year n/a); also bought a 13-property IOS truck terminal portfolio across seven major US markets (realterm.com). Realterm is also an active IOS lender: $115M to GreenPoint Partners/Outpost for a 6-property portfolio incl. NJ plus a $300M credit facility (Commercial Observer, 2026-02) and $71M for eight industrial properties (2025-01). HQ Annapolis MD stated from prior knowledge of firm; not confirmed in this pass.
